scripts.lint: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check backend && tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format backend && prettier --write frontend scripts package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check backend && prettier --check frontend scripts package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
